review_note: Independent mathematical review confirmed the dense per-group Laplace oracle for the Poisson log-link correlated q2 block (1 + x | id) with Sigma = D R D. It is written in plain R with a damped Newton mode search, analytic Hessian Z' diag(mu) Z + Sigma^-1, and log|Sigma| and log|H| terms, and shares nothing with TMB. It is evaluated at the fitted beta, rho and predict()-derived group SDs, and matched at 1e-4 over seeds 20261027 and 20261101. Both linked rows are supported (mu:I via sd(coef = '(Intercept)') ~ w, and mu:x1 via sd(coef = 'x') ~ v, distinct predictors that genuinely vary). Emulated-bug sensitivity exists: swapped SD targets, flipped rho sign and one-level misalignment each move the oracle by more than 1 log-likelihood unit. Manifest rehash: 2 of 5 entries mismatch (R/drmTMB.R and src/drmTMB.cpp), both matching commit 33e4e966a exactly. I read the full 33e4e966a..HEAD diff of both files and of R/methods.R. The changes are Gaussian q3/q4 per-coefficient SD (gated on re_cov_sd_row0 and has_sd_mu_model), missing-response include relaxations (inactive for complete responses), the false-convergence nlminb restart, and q2 simulate and summary changes. None alters the complete-response Poisson ordinary q2 likelihood. The test file hash is unchanged and the focused test was rerun on the current tree with the receipt's count. Scope: native Poisson, log link, one unlabelled q2 intercept-slope block with two group-constant SD predictors. It does not establish calibration or coverage, other families or providers, or Julia parity.
